description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of different methods, labeled as Standard, Self-RAG, FactTuneClnGS (w/), and ClnGS, in a certain context. The vertical axis, representing average performance, is linear and ranges from 0 to 60, with a tick label interval of 10. The horizontal axis lists the methods. The Standard method has an average performance of approximately 50, the Self-RAG method is slightly higher, around 55, the FactTuneClnGS (w/) method is around 50, and the ClnGS method has the highest average performance, close to 60. The bars are not sorted in any specific order and there are no bars visually emphasized.
